name: tidybeam
description: Fast, local-first file manager, deep cleaner, and system optimizer for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --workspace --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint:rust && npm run test:rust
